# Virtual human assets (third party)

Copied on 2026-11-19 from the team's `virtual-humans-main` Unity project (`Virtual Humans/Assets/...`):

| Here | Source |
|---|---|
| `Young_kev/Young_kev.fbx` + `Textures/` | `Virtual Agents (Reallusion)/Reallusion/white_male_young/Young_kev.Fbx` + `Young_kev.fbm/` |
| `Young_cami/Young_cami.fbx` + `Textures/` | `Virtual Agents (Reallusion)/Reallusion/white_female_young/Young_cami.Fbx` + `Young_cami.fbm/` |
| `Animations/SittingIdle.fbx` | `Animations/Idle Animation/SittingIdle.fbx` |
| `Chair/black_chair.fbx` | `black_chair/black_chair.fbx` |

The characters were made with Reallusion Character Creator; use them under the licence terms of whoever owns the
source project. Only the rigged models, their diffuse/normal/opacity textures, the seated idle clip and the chair were
copied. The original CC Unity Tools materials/shaders, prefabs, scripts, speech and LLM components were not.
Materials, the seated animator and the avatar prefabs are generated by **XR Study → Task 1 → Set Up Virtual Humans**.
